attack_techniques: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Cloud Firewall (T1562.007)
attackers_goals: Bypass security measures to gain access to cloud resources.
description: An Azure Firewall rule collection group was modified or deleted. This could indicate a malicious actor attempting to bypass security measures.
investigative_actions: Check the Azure Firewall rule collection group to identify the modified or deleted rules.
name: An Azure Firewall rule collection group was modified or deleted
